mechanism.claim: A completed daily VVIX/VIX relative-convexity change that is confirmed by same-direction BVOL and DVOL repricing during the next Cboe source date 09:00-10:00 ET hour identifies cross-domain convexity-risk transmission; rising relative convexity maps to short BTC and falling relative convexity maps to long BTC for six hours.
mechanism.side: negative sign of completed Cboe delta log(VVIX/VIX)
mechanism.why_distinct: CCXTR uses no BTC price confirmation and transmits relative convexity rather than the VIX level. CCVTR used delta log VIX; CCVDAR used Cboe front-slope disagreement with opposite crypto-vol movement rather than same-direction convexity transmission.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official Cboe relative-convexity-to-crypto implied-volatility transmission at next-session 10:05 ET is absent from Gross9

features.cboe_relative_convexity_change: current minus immediately previous exact Cboe observation of log(VVIX/VIX); nonzero, no magnitude threshold
features.crypto_opening_hour: next exact Cboe source date [09:00,10:00) America/New_York
features.bvol_body: completed-hour (close-open)/open, same nonzero sign as Cboe relative-convexity change
features.dvol_body: completed-hour (close-open)/open, same nonzero sign as Cboe relative-convexity change
features.availability: Cboe observation complete before next source date; crypto candles complete at 10:00 ET

clock.entry: next exact Cboe source date 10:05 America/New_York

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
